Did you forget to hide your snacks again?
Yeah! What if—\n　Ah! Save it for later! We gotta focus!
We can't just stand here/ we gotta do something!
Maybe we should look for a way out.

Let's not open that can of worms...
This calls for a little prank.

And I—\n　...think they saw us coming!
Oh/ this is going to be great.
A is for... Argh/ I forgot!
Okay Star/ you be the leader this time.
We'll attack at the count of three.
You want to show them how close we are/ right?

Let's switch things up a bit.
How about we have Luna kick us off?
Huh? You mean/ I have to say the thing?

I think Luna should lead the attack this time.
Are you sure? You know how much of a klutz she is.

When there's only one of us/\n　nothing really seems right...
When there's only two of us/\n　it feels like something's missing...

Girls/ it's time we settled this!
And to top it off/ my powerful sunlight!
The power of three becomes one...
The power of three becomes one... NOW!
We need to surpass our limits!
We are the Three Fairies of Light!
Shine like you've never shined before!
We are the Three Fairies of Light!
At least I'm good at dodging.
Not much we can do if they attack us from that far away/ can we?
Your sacrifice will not be in vain!
Say no more. We're going to avenge them!
Please don't use us like shields just because we can heal.
Why does Cirno have to be so reckless...?
Nobody gets to mess with her but us!\n　It's payback time!
This totally makes me the new leader/ right?
Sunny/ this really isn't the time.
Dai gave everything she had to protect us...!
She cares so much for us... We need to repay her kindness!
Should we really be using our friends like shields...?
It'll be like/ so awkward later/ huh?
Leave the risky stuff to us/ Dai!
We fairies have to stick together.
Alice! She... She just saved us...
We can't just run away after this/ dang it!
Rumia never really focuses on one thing for more than a few seconds/ huh?

Then we'd better step in and help her.
Wait/ what?\n　Did Marisa just cover our butts?

Sorry/ that's just how it works.
You can't beat my fairy spirit!
We could do this all day!
Health is one of our strong points.
That's not a reason to get careless/ Luna.
Well/ we took that straight on...
Just get ready for the next one!
Oh/ Luna. You're such a klutz.
Classic Luna. You're such a klutz.
Okay/ so that's what happens when we get hit...
I'd say we're better suited for giving rather than taking.
I'm not exactly having a lot of fun here...
Come on girls/ keep your chin up.
Do you think we can pull through/ Sunny?
If nothing else comes our way/ maybe...
You seem to be doing perfectly fine for some reason...
Girls/ did you see that? We dodged!
Yes/ Luna. We were there/ too.
You'd think one of us would have been hit.
No thanks to me/ I bet...
I could do this with my eyes closed!
Glad to have you on front/ Sunny.
You love it when it works.
Huh. Who knew you could just... slap 'em off?
Why don't we just get a head start?

Well/ they caught us all at once.
It wasn't supposed to end this way...
Awww/ I was so sure grouping up was the right idea...

We hope you enjoyed this episode.
We're leaving the rest to you!

Well/ they caught us all at once.
It wasn't supposed to end this way...
At least we went down fighting!
We're leaving the rest to you!
We'll cheer you on from the sidelines!
God or not/ we gotta fight!

Together/ the three of us can do anything!
Those dangerous women are too tall.\n　We're the perfect size.
Sorry for the whole three-against-one" thing!
Those dangerous women are too tall.\n　We're the perfect size.
We can beat you any day/ Cirno!
